label: CLOTH
name: Dual-arm cloth
method: Distance-constrained particles with structural, shear and bending links; two independently targeted arms.
objective: Bring opposing cloth regions together while maintaining valid grasps.
limits: No cloth self-collision or material calibration; fold progress is a geometric proxy.

label: PLUG
name: Peg-in-hole assembly
method: Rigid-body contact and a hollow socket with explicit radial and angular insertion checks.
objective: Align a cylindrical peg with the socket and reach the required insertion depth.
limits: The socket uses a discretized collision wall; this is not a force-controlled industrial assembly model.

label: PUSH-T
name: Contact-driven Push-T
method: A compound T rigid body, contact impulses, planar constraints and friction.
objective: Push the T body toward its goal position and orientation.
limits: Planar motion and a heuristic feedback controller; no learned policy or optimality guarantee.

label: BOX
name: Multi-object packing
method: Rigid bodies, lock grasps, gravity, container walls and geometric containment tests.
objective: Place and release three objects within the open container.
limits: Small fixed object set; no general bin-packing optimizer.

label: MARKER
name: Slender-tool insertion
method: A long rigid tool, tracked tip and tilted narrow holder with orientation-sensitive contact.
objective: Reorient the marker and guide its tip into the inclined holder.
limits: Simplified cylindrical contact geometry; no flexible-tool or tactile model.

label: ROPE
name: Rope threading
method: A particle chain with length constraints, a segmented ring collider and directed plane-crossing tests.
objective: Guide a grasped endpoint through the ring opening and pull a rope segment through.
limits: No knot topology or rope self-collision; ring collision is an explicit geometric approximation.
